name: wpa_supplicant
description: Cross-platform supplicant for WPA, WPA2/RSN, and IEEE 802.1X, implementing key negotiation with a WPA authenticator and IEEE 802.11i/WPA/WPA2/WPA3 network authentication. Also includes wpa_cli and wpa_passphrase.
build:
cd wpa_supplicant-2.11/wpa_supplicant && cat > .config << 'EOF'
CONFIG_BACKEND=file
CONFIG_CTRL_IFACE=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_FILE=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_SYSLOG=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_SYSLOG_FACILITY=LOG_DAEMON
CONFIG_DRIVER_NL80211=y
CONFIG_DRIVER_WEXT=y
CONFIG_DRIVER_WIRED=y
CONFIG_EAP_FAST=y
CONFIG_EAP_GTC=y
CONFIG_EAP_LEAP=y
CONFIG_EAP_MD5=y
CONFIG_EAP_MSCHAPV2=y
CONFIG_EAP_OTP=y
CONFIG_EAP_PEAP=y
CONFIG_EAP_PWD=y
CONFIG_EAP_TLS=y
CONFIG_EAP_TTLS=y
CONFIG_IEEE8021X_EAPOL=y
CONFIG_IPV6=y
CONFIG_LIBNL32=y
CONFIG_PKCS12=y
CONFIG_READLINE=y
CONFIG_SAE=y
CONFIG_SMARTCARD=y
CONFIG_WPS=y
EOF
install: cd wpa_supplicant-2.11/wpa_supplicant && install -m755 wpa_supplicant wpa_cli wpa_passphrase "$DESTDIR$PREFIX/sbin/"
